In Point Fermin, walls often want width - long, low compositions that stretch the room. In Vista del Oro, the same stone and marble wall tends to run taller and simpler. Starting from your room photo is what lets us tune that rhythm to your street instead of shipping a showroom layout.

What makes a stone and marble wall work is proportion. We size panels, cabinets and screen together, so nothing looks added-on and nothing fights the room.

How we build a stone and marble wall

Stone is unforgiving: every seam, vein and edge is on display forever. We plan the slab layout before ordering so veins flow across the wall the way the design shows, use large-format porcelain for a marble look without marble upkeep, and set with leveling systems so faces sit perfectly flush. Grout lines are kept thin and color-matched. The result reads as one continuous stone surface - around a TV, a fireplace or a full living-room wall.

Stone & Marble Walls in San Pedro - common questions

How much does a stone or marble feature wall cost in San Pedro?

In San Pedro, stone feature walls start at $9,800. Material choice moves the number most: porcelain marble-look sits at the efficient end, natural stone and book-matched layouts above it. Your estimate separates material from labor, so the trade-offs are visible before you decide.

How are the seams handled?

The layout is templated first, veins are planned to continue piece to piece, and joints are held to 1-2mm with color-matched fill. From across the room the wall reads as a single stone face.

Can stone go around a fireplace?

Yes - surrounds are a specialty. We stay inside the fireplace maker's heat clearances and use rated setting materials, so the stone is safe and the warranty on your unit stays intact.

How long does a stone wall take?

Most San Pedro stone walls take 4 to 6 on-site days once material is in hand. Layout and cutting follow templates made in advance, which keeps dust and surprises down.
